score_evidence: 'Candelytics is developing a proprietary LIDAR-based software solution...Our mission is to democratize access to 3D data and revolutionize human interaction with the physical world' plus 'demonstrated our technology...via nine virtual demonstrations and two on-site demonstrations' → lab_language_intensity (demo-count bragging, mission-statement grandiosity, zero fielding framing)

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Cloud-native' spatial data hosting assumes persistent connectivity to upload/sync point cloud files
blind_spots.operator_reality: Rapid airfield damage assessment (their own RADAS use case) happens at contested or austere airstrips where DDIL comms deny the cloud round-trip their entire architecture is built on — same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product and pricing are built for commercial surveying/drone-mapping customers (city surveyors, drone shops) where broadband is a given
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Stitch3D connects teams with cloud-native spatial data management, visualization, and business intelligence

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Industry's first real-time multiplayer web viewer' for up to 50 simultaneous users
blind_spots.operator_reality: A 50-user real-time collaborative session requires sustained bandwidth no contested airfield or forward site has; there is no offline/degraded-mode viewer described anywhere
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Feature was built to win commercial reality-capture customers (Pix4D-competitor positioning), not for field-degraded ops
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The industry's first real-time multiplayer web viewer that lets up to 50 users simultaneously markup, annotate, and comment

blind_spots.blind_spot: No ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR language despite handling sensitive military geometry (naval ship scans, airfield damage data, smuggling-compartment annotations for DEA/CBP)
blind_spots.operator_reality: If this data is uploaded to their commercial multi-tenant cloud without an ATO or documented compliance boundary, it's a contract-killing gap the moment a program office asks about data handling
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Tiny 4-6 person team with no compliance function visible; company narrative (TechCrunch) centers on a founder's personal frustration story, not acquisition process fluency
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Candelytics has developed prototype software that allowed Coast Guard operators to execute basic change detection...and added features that allowed users to annotate voids and suspicious areas that could represent smuggling compartments

opener_hook: Stitch3D ran two Air Force SBIR Phase IIs on RADAS airfield-damage assessment and demoed live to Coast Guard Sectors San Diego and Miami — is the platform on a path to an ATO for that data yet?
what_they_do: Cloud-native SaaS platform (formerly Candelytics) for hosting, viewing, and collaboratively analyzing LIDAR point-cloud data, sold mainly to commercial reality-capture/survey customers with defense demos in airfield damage assessment and Coast Guard smuggling detection.
